desc: Read input N and the adjacency matrix. Initialize the answer matrix `ans` with infinity (or -1) and a distance matrix `dist` for the BFS with infinity.
Iterate over all possible centers (vertices $c$ for odd length, edges $(u, v)$ for even length).
For each center, run a BFS on states $(x, y)$ representing the current endpoints of the left and right parts of the palindrome.
Update the `ans` matrix with the shortest palindrome lengths found.
